name: Hamburg Airport

runway.v: two crossing runways: 05/23 3,666 m and 15/33 3,250 m
runway.quote: With lengths of 3,250 meters (runway 15/33) and 3,666 meters (runway 05/23)

hours.quote: Flight operations from 6:00 am to 11:00 pm

curfew.v: strict night restrictions from 23:00; only scheduled commercial flights with proven unavoidable delays may still operate until 24:00; from 00:00 to 06:00 only flights with a prior, paid exemption from the environment authority (BUKEA)
curfew.quote: In der Zeit von Mitternacht bis 6 Uhr morgens sind ausschließlich Flüge

notes: DFS AIP not read (not openable in earlier runs). Facts from the operator's airline-partner page (no page date) and its night-restriction report for July 2026 (dated 10 Aug 2026). The 23:00-24:00 delay allowance applies only to scheduled commercial flights, so a business jet needs the BUKEA exemption after 23:00 in practice. A separate general aviation terminal exists (operator's company portrait page), but customs hours and handling rules were not found in an official source.
